title: Compute GRPO Group Relative Advantages
seoDescription: Normalize rollout rewards within each contiguous prompt group and deactivate groups with no reward variation.
description:
Normalize candidate rollout rewards within contiguous prompt groups and deactivate advantage gradients when no reward variance is observed.

**Mathematical Formulation:**

$$
A_i = \begin{cases} \frac{R_i - \text{mean}(R)}{\text{std}(R) + \epsilon}, & \text{if } \text{std}(R) > 0 \\ 0, & \text{if } \text{std}(R) = 0 \end{cases}
$$

**Step-by-Step Implementation:**
1. Compute sample standard deviation of rewards within the prompt candidate group.
2. If reward variance is zero, return all zeros to deactivate gradients.
3. Standardize rewards by subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation.
4. Return list of relative advantage values.

**Returns:** List of normalized group advantage floats.

### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Normalize candidate rollout rewards within contiguous prompt groups and deactivate advantage gradients when no reward variance is observed.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def cs336_l16_grpo_group_advantages(rewards: list) -> list:
    r = np.array(rewards, dtype=float)
    std = np.std(r)
    if std < 1e-12: return [0.0] * len(rewards)
    return np.round((r - np.mean(r)) / (std + 1e-8), 6).tolist()
```
